PASubtitle: Welcome synthetic attendee aliases to a paper-shape session.
ActivityDescription: Practise a welcome-desk check-in for an invented paper-shape workshop. Use only the synthetic aliases Maple, Cobalt, and Pebble; do not collect real attendee information.
TrainerGuidelines:
Explain that the roster and attendance are fictional.
Demonstrate one alias lookup, then let the learner handle the remaining aliases.
Pause if an alias is absent or already checked in; ask for clarification instead of adding or duplicating a record.
DesiredLearningOutcome: The learner can welcome an attendee alias, record one check-in, and reconcile the fictional roster without collecting personal information.
WhatIsNeeded:
Practice roster listing Maple, Cobalt, and Pebble with empty check-in boxes
Three reusable alias cards
Pencil
Welcome sign for the paper-shape session
SkillsBasedLearningObjectives:
Locate a synthetic alias on a practice roster.
Record one check-in without creating a duplicate.
Reconcile check-in marks against the three alias cards.
DocumentationAndReferences: Fictional paper-shape workshop guide supplied with this demo. No external reference or course identifier is supplied.
ActivitySteps:
Arrange the welcome sign, blank practice roster, alias cards, and pencil.
Greet the card holder and read the synthetic alias together.
Find the matching roster entry and confirm that its check-in box is empty.
Mark one check-in and direct the card holder to the paper-shape session.
Repeat for the remaining cards, then reconcile the three marks and reset the practice roster.
Validation:
All three synthetic aliases have exactly one check-in mark before the reset.
The learner explains how to handle a missing alias or a duplicate check-in.
No real names, contact details, or attendance records are collected.
Notes: Fictional fixture replay, not live AI generation. All attendee aliases are synthetic. Unspecified metadata remains TBD; review the worksheet before use.
